name: the documentation example: field 1 is 150
ref: Protocol Buffers encoding guide: 08 96 01 is a=150

example.title: Read field 1, a varint of 150
example.note: The key 08 means field 1 with a varint value, and the value bytes 96 01 are 150.

name: the documentation example: field 2 is the string "testing"
ref: Protocol Buffers encoding guide: 12 07 "testing"

example.title: A length-delimited field read as text
example.note: The key 12 is field 2 with a length, 07 is the length, and the seven bytes after it read as the text testing.
